prompt: A 62-year-old male, who has previously been diagnosed with hepatitis C, presents to the clinic for his annual check-up. He reports feeling generally well but is concerned about the progression of his liver condition. Recent blood tests show an AST of 68 IU/L and an ALT of 72 IU/L. His platelet count is recorded at 140 x 10⁹/L. The hepatologist wants to evaluate the risk of liver fibrosis in this patient and decides to calculate the FIB-4 index to determine if further liver assessment is needed. What is the FIB-4 Score in this patient?

rubric_items.text: Interprets the calculated value as "Advanced fibrosis likely" (accept equivalent clinical phrasing).
